other_sec_8k_evidence.title: 8-K exhibit: 0000950142-26-001733.txt
other_sec_8k_evidence.claim: Eaton announced it entered into a definitive agreement with Dana Incorporated regarding separation of Eaton's mobility business.
other_sec_8k_evidence.summary: The 8-K discloses a definitive agreement with Dana tied to Eaton's mobility business separation.
other_sec_8k_evidence.excerpt: On June 11, 2026, Eaton Corporation plc (the “Company”) issued a press release announcing the Company’s entry into a definitive agreement with Dana Incorporated, a Delaware corporation (“Merger Partner”), regarding the separation of the Company’s mobility business.

other_sec_8k_evidence.title: 8-K exhibit: 0000950142-26-001733.txt
other_sec_8k_evidence.claim: Eaton will separate its Mobility segment and combine it with Dana in a Reverse Morris Trust transaction.
other_sec_8k_evidence.summary: The filing specifies the planned structure as a Mobility separation followed by a combination with Dana through a Reverse Morris Trust.
other_sec_8k_evidence.excerpt: On June 10, 2026, the Company entered into definitive agreements with Merger Partner pursuant to which the Company will separate its Mobility segment (the “SpinCo Business”) and combine it with Merger Partner in a Reverse Morris Trust transaction.

other_sec_8k_evidence.title: 8-K exhibit: 0000950142-26-001733.txt
other_sec_8k_evidence.claim: Immediately before the merger, Eaton plans to transfer the Mobility business to SpinCo and distribute SpinCo common stock to Eaton shareholders.
other_sec_8k_evidence.summary: Eaton describes the pre-merger separation mechanics, including transfer of the Mobility business to SpinCo and distribution of SpinCo shares to shareholders.
other_sec_8k_evidence.excerpt: the Company will, among other things and subject to the terms and conditions of the Separation Agreement, transfer the SpinCo Business to SpinCo and its subsidiaries and, in connection therewith, will distribute to the Company shareholders shares of common stock of SpinCo (the “Distribution”).

other_sec_8k_evidence.title: 8-K exhibit: 0000950142-26-001733.txt
other_sec_8k_evidence.claim: After the distribution, a SpinCo subsidiary will merge with Dana, with Dana surviving as a direct wholly owned subsidiary of SpinCo.
other_sec_8k_evidence.summary: The filing details the post-distribution merger mechanics and surviving entity.
other_sec_8k_evidence.excerpt: Immediately following the Distribution and pursuant to an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the “Merger Agreement”) with Eaton Ohio, SpinCo, Atlas Mobility Sub, Inc., a Delaware corporation and wholly owned subsidiary of SpinCo (“Merger Sub”), Merger Sub will be merged with and into Merger Partner (the “Merger”), with Merger Partner surviving and continuing as the surviving corporation of the Merger and as a direct, wholly owned subsidiary of SpinCo.

other_sec_8k_evidence.title: 8-K exhibit: 0000950142-26-001733.txt
other_sec_8k_evidence.claim: Dana shareholders will receive SpinCo shares based on an exchange ratio specified in the merger agreement, subject to adjustment.
other_sec_8k_evidence.summary: The consideration to Dana shareholders is SpinCo shares using an exchange ratio in the merger agreement.
other_sec_8k_evidence.excerpt: Subject to the terms and conditions of the Merger Agreement, at closing, each share of common stock of Merger Partner that is outstanding as of immediately prior to the closing will be converted into the right to receive a number of SpinCo shares equal to the exchange ratio specified in the Merger Agreement, subject to adjustment.

other_sec_8k_evidence.title: 8-K exhibit: 0000950142-26-001733.txt
other_sec_8k_evidence.claim: Eaton expects to receive approximately $1.1 billion in cash distribution from the transaction.
other_sec_8k_evidence.summary: The filing states Eaton will receive about $1.1 billion in cash distribution under the merger agreement.
other_sec_8k_evidence.excerpt: Under the terms of the Merger Agreement, the Company will receive approximately $1.1 billion in cash distribution

other_sec_8k_evidence.title: 8-K exhibit: 0000950142-26-001733.txt
other_sec_8k_evidence.claim: Eaton shareholders are expected to own at least 50.1% of the combined company after the transaction closes.
other_sec_8k_evidence.summary: The filing specifies intended majority ownership of the combined company by Eaton shareholders.
other_sec_8k_evidence.excerpt: the Company shareholders will receive newly issued shares of the combined company such that the Company shareholders will own at least 50.1% of the combined company’s outstanding shares following the consummation of the transaction.

other_sec_8k_evidence.title: 8-K exhibit: 0000950142-26-001733-index-headers.html
other_sec_8k_evidence.claim: The 8-K was filed under Item 7.01 Regulation FD Disclosure, Item 8.01 Other Events, and Item 9.01 Financial Statements and Exhibits.
other_sec_8k_evidence.summary: The EDGAR header identifies the 8-K items used for the disclosure.
other_sec_8k_evidence.excerpt: ITEM INFORMATION: Regulation FD Disclosure ITEM INFORMATION: Other Events ITEM INFORMATION: Financial Statements and Exhibits
other_sec_8k_evidence.notes: This is filing metadata, included because it identifies the disclosure framework for the transaction filing.

other_sec_8k_evidence.title: 8-K exhibit: eh260792115_8k.htm
other_sec_8k_evidence.claim: Eaton's Form 8-K states the company entered definitive agreements with Dana on June 10, 2026 for a Mobility segment separation and combination.
other_sec_8k_evidence.summary: The primary Form 8-K repeats the central transaction announcement and structure.
other_sec_8k_evidence.excerpt: On June 10, 2026, the Company entered into definitive agreements with Merger Partner pursuant to which the Company will separate its Mobility segment (the “SpinCo Business”) and combine it with Merger Partner in a Reverse Morris Trust transaction.

other_sec_8k_evidence.title: 8-K exhibit: eh260792115_8k.htm
other_sec_8k_evidence.claim: The Form 8-K says Eaton will receive about $1.1 billion in cash and Eaton shareholders will own at least 50.1% of the combined company after consummation.
other_sec_8k_evidence.summary: The primary Form 8-K provides key economic terms for Eaton and its shareholders.
other_sec_8k_evidence.excerpt: Under the terms of the Merger Agreement, the Company will receive approximately $1.1 billion in cash distribution and the Company shareholders will receive newly issued shares of the combined company such that the Company shareholders will own at least 50.1% of the combined company’s outstanding shares following the consummation of the transaction.
